components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, every non-digit
            character is stripped and the remaining digits must number exactly
            ten; the stored and returned value is that 10-digit string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:

## Summary

I changed telephone handling from the old "10-digit, digits-only" scheme to E.164 storage and comparison.

**What E.164 normalization now does** (in `OwnerRestControllerV1.normalizeTelephone`):
- Strips spaces, dashes and brackets.
- If a leading `+` is present, keeps it and its country code as supplied.
- Otherwise assumes country code `+61` and drops a single leading `0` from the national digits.
- Requires the result to be `+` followed by 8–15 digits, else throws `InvalidTelephoneException` → 400.
- So `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`, `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456`, and `12` is rejected.

**Files changed:**
1. `rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java` — rewrote `normalizeTelephone` to produce E.164; also normalize telephone on update; the duplicate check already compares the stored strings, which are now E.164 (so national/international forms of the same number collide).
2. `model/Owner.java` — replaced the `@Digits(integer=10)` + `^[0-9]{10}$` constraints (which would reject the `+`) with `@Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")` so JPA persistence accepts the E.164 value; removed the now-unused `Digits` import.
3. `rest/controller/InvalidTelephoneException.java` — updated the message to describe the E.164 failure.
4. `resources/openapi.yml` — updated the `telephone` field description and example to document the E.164 behaviour (`maxLength: 20` already accommodates the value).

The duplicate-detection now compares E.164 values (`Cp03` passes), national numbers convert correctly (`Cp02`/`Cp08`), explicit country codes are preserved, unformattable numbers return 400, and the existing blank/missing-field validation is untouched (`Cp01`).
